[The torus](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A17-Toroidal-Circulation-and-the-Arche-Topos.md) is whole through the opening it retains; circulation unfolds that already inseparable relation. Its exact quotient is `T²=R²/Z²`. Four polygon sides before gluing and two independent generating cycles give the topological `4+2` correspondence; after gluing the cell count is one vertex, two edges and one face, so `χ(T²)=1−2+1=0`. The fundamental group `π₁(T²)=Z×Z` records independent windings, not one loop and its reverse. The Riemann sphere, projective line, quotient circle, Möbius and Klein surfaces, covering spaces, and other constructions remain distinct apertures because each discloses different invariants; the torus is primary here because circulation, winding, retained displacement, and return converge on one surface.
The relation between the infinite covering plane and the finite torus is itself a decisive infinity/determination structure. Under `π: R²→T²`, every exact surface-point corresponds to an infinite lattice of pre-images on the cover. The quotient gives that infinity a determinate address while retaining it in the fibres. In the QL register this is the strict topological carrier of `∞/0`: the expression names an infinite cover identified into a compact surface with `χ(T²)=0`, rather than arithmetic division, and each surface-address retains infinitely many lifted representatives. A closed surface loop can lift to a displaced path on the plane, so local return retains an integer winding class. The lifted path and its timing carry further information which the endpoint displacement alone does not retain. Rational-slope linear flows return periodically while irrational-slope flows wind densely; the torus can therefore hold cadence and inexhaustible traversal on the same surface.
### §5→0 · #4 — Idealism: source, means and determinate being
Within Life / Mind, Subjective Immediacy is the knower, Objective Internality the constituted means, and World the known. The order **Subject / Consciousness → constituted means → determinate object** is positive ontology: determinate being is being-disclosed within this whole relation. A causal account explains the production of things through other things; adding a represented cause does not make the whole relation arise from one of its own determinations. The private ego is itself a formation within it. [The argument of dependence](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A34-Idealism-Order-of-Dependence.md) and [its reusable concept](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C60-Idealism-Order-of-Dependence.md) carry this derivation.
The directions of dependence must remain distinguishable. A reflection can be encountered before its source is understood and can cause a later event, while remaining dependent in being. A local Bimba can genuinely ground a bounded inquiry while remaining a pratibimba of wider sources. Epistemic precedence, causal efficacy, logical priority, conditions of possible experience and ontological dependence answer different questions. Recognition makes their crossings available without dissolving the reality or power of the determination.
Artificial agency supplies a consequential technical articulation of the means. A model can act into the world it will later model; an encounter can correct an observation, alter a model, revise a criterion or reach the commission. The achieved `1` returns toward its source through the full crossed-zero recognition, retaining the source–means–known relation within Life / Mind. This return changes what a subsequent act can inherit while leaving the Subject-condition unobjectified.
- Whether the idealist order of dependence receives compact treatment in §5→0 · #4 or additional development in an appendix. The positive ontology developed in the argument, concept and terminal section is retained in either form; the prose envelope remains a compositional choice.
